entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:112657
Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22815 of 2023

Applicant :- Jose Prakash George And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mary Puncha (Sheeb Jose),Mohd. Kalim

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants with a prayer to release them on bail in Case Crime No.60 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 506, 120-B I.P.C., &
Section 3 & 5 (1) U.P. Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act, P.S. Kotwali, District Fatehpur, during pendency of trial.

entities.text: U.P. Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case.

He next argued that identically placed co-accused, namely,
Anju Rani and Bhanu Pratap Singh have been granted bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide Jose Prakash George And Another vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184636311/
1 order dated 04.04.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 13775 of 2023.

entities.text: Jose Prakash George And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 13775 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
He further submits that since the role of the applicants are not distinguishable with the role of co-accused,
therefore, the applicants are also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
They are languishing in jail since 10.02.2023.
In case, they are released on bail, they will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicants but could not dispute the facts narrated by counsel for the applicants.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicants, Jose Prakash George and Daud Masih be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicants shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Meenu Singh  Jose Prakash George And Another vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184636311/
